description: Install in User settings to cover every project. Dependency cooldown: npm, pnpm and uv skip any version published less than 7 days ago in everything Claude Code starts (Bash commands, npx/uvx MCP servers, hooks), so a hijacked release or a freshly registered name an AI made up (slopsquatting) fails to resolve instead of installing. A command that mentions the cooldown settings, for example to skip them with --min-release-age=0, asks you first (denied in claude -p). Your .npmrc is untouched. Needs npm 11.10+ (older npm ignores it silently), pnpm 11+ or a recent uv (tested on 0.11); pip, yarn and bun are not covered. Units: npm days, pnpm minutes, uv a duration. Docs: https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/using-npm/config#min-release-age
